description: This file defines the 'PoissonDistribution' class, which implements the Poisson probability distribution, including methods for probability calculations, sampling, and distribution properties within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: PoissonDistribution
classes.description: Implements the Poisson distribution with methods for probability calculations, sampling, and distribution properties, utilizing normal and exponential approximations for efficiency.

methods.name: PoissonDistribution
methods.description: Constructors for the PoissonDistribution class, allowing specification of mean, convergence criteria, maximum iterations, and random generator.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function (PMF) for a given integer x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of the PMF for a given integer x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function (CDF) up to integer x using the regularized Gamma function.

methods.name: normalApproximateProbability
methods.description: Estimates the probability using a normal distribution approximation with half-correction.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower support bound, always 0.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper support bound, approximated as Integer.MAX_VALUE.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support of the distribution is connected (always true).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the Poisson distribution using rejection algorithms for small and large means.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Helper method to generate a Poisson-distributed sample, employing different algorithms depending on the mean.
